ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The die at the starting point in the image has three visible faces: the top is 3 dots, the front is 2 dots, and the right face is 1 dot. The route from Start to End first goes right through two squares, then follows a diagonally down-left connecting segment to the lower row, and then continues right through three squares. Reasoning: Opposite faces have dot sums of 7, so initially the bottom=4, the back=5, and the left face=6. Track the top face along the route R, R, F, R, R, R: the initial top face is 3; after the first roll to the right, the left face 6 goes to the top; after the second roll to the right, the bottom 4 goes to the top; after rolling in the front/diagonal direction, the back face 5 goes to the top; then rolling right three more times, the top faces are respectively 1, 2, 6. Therefore the top face at the end point is 6.

method.method_draft: Direct orientation tracking. From the image, read the die’s visible starting faces: top is 3, front face is 2, and right face is 1. From the circuit, count the route from Start to End as two rolls to the right, one roll along the slanted/down-left connector to the lower row, then three more rolls to the right. From the text, use that opposite faces add to 7, so bottom is 4, back is 5, and left is 6. Apply the standard roll update for each move: rolling right makes the left face become top; rolling along the down-left/front direction makes the back face become top. Tracking the six moves R, R, F, R, R, R gives final top face 6.

method.method_draft: Rotation/permutation method. From the image, encode the starting die orientation as coordinate directions: top 3, right 1, front 2; therefore bottom 4, left 6, back 5 by the opposite-sum rule. Also read the circuit as the motion word R^2 F R^3: two rightward rolls, one front/down-left roll, then three rightward rolls. Instead of listing every visible face state, compose the corresponding cube rotations as a permutation of face positions. Apply the permutation R^2 F R^3 to the initial face-position labels, or equivalently ask which initial face is carried to the final top position. The composed rotation sends the initial left face to the final top. Since the initial left face is opposite the initial right face 1, its number is 6.
